## 2. Scheduling rationale

- **Miles must interview Tuesday:** Thursday is his only alternative, but Jane is out that day.
- **Roe therefore takes Wednesday:** Scheduling both candidates Tuesday would exceed each interviewer’s one-final-round-session-per-day limit.
- Miles starts at Chicago’s earliest permitted time, 09:00. Jane’s session begins exactly when her Tuesday busy block ends, at 15:00 Berlin time. Coding runs after Mary’s 11:00–12:00 New York conflict; putting it immediately after system design would overlap that conflict.
- Both loops avoid John’s standup. Every participant’s own sessions fall within their 09:00–17:00 local working hours, with the required breaks.
